title: Implement V4 P9.2 read and query contracts
goal: Add schema-versioned Host-owned project, profile, prerequisite, run, evidence and Plan catalog projections without exposing internal files as UI authorities or changing released stable CLI behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A registered experimental query command contract defines six read-only Host commands without modifying the released stable CLI command set.
Project, profile and prerequisite projections derive only from package-validated Host authorities.
Run and evidence projections validate registered state and Stage result contracts and use deterministic IDs and hashes rather than timestamps.
Plan catalog projection validates V4-native Plans through the V4 Plan runtime and labels V3-formal pairs as read-only historical compatibility views.
Every query output satisfies a strict registered schema and malformed, linked or escaping inputs fail closed.
All queries leave PackageRoot, TargetRoot, StateRoot and EvidenceRoot byte-identical on Windows and Linux.
No Stage Runner, authority edit, Target mutation, reset, Git operation, remote access or remote activation is introduced.
